$comment: Model routing reference. Prefer subscription models over API-billed. Fallback chain: Gemini (sub) -> Codex (sub) -> OpenAI API -> Sonnet (API) -> Opus (API) -> Qwen 3.6 local -> Nemotron 3 Super local. OpenClaw 2026.6.8 recognises Anthropic Opus 4.7 and GitHub Copilot GPT-5.5, but GPT-5.5 is not available as openai-codex/gpt-5.5. Keep the current tested chain until an explicit model-policy adoption pass succeeds.

main_chat.rationale: Fast, cheap, good for general conversation. Subscription via google-gemini-cli OAuth.

coding.rationale: Strong coding on subscription. Use /model gpt-5.4 in Coding topic. GPT-5.5 is catalogued for GitHub Copilot in OpenClaw 2026.6.8, but not for openai-codex.

deep_research.rationale: Strong reasoning on subscription via Codex OAuth.

crons_lightweight.rationale: Lightweight checks. No need for frontier models.

crons_heavy.rationale: Memory synthesis and doc drift on subscription.

precision.rationale: Best-in-class reasoning fallback. API-billed. Use only when Codex falls short. Opus 4.7 is catalogued in OpenClaw 2026.6.8 but has not been adopted into the tested fallback chain yet.

local_fallback.rationale: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B MoE: ~3B active params per token for fast inference. Free, local Metal GPU. Released 2026-04-16. OpenAI-compatible tool_calls verified via direct /v1/chat/completions probe.

local_precision.rationale: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super: 120B hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE, 12B active. Higher-quality local option when latency is less critical. 86 GB on disk, ~2 min cold-load on 96 GB unified memory.
